story.body: You heard Heminges refuse a figure from a box that was not all down. Monday's eleven pound eight stayed Monday's. You did not open the coffer, and you did not fold Edith's eight shillings into the afternoon. Burbage had you out of the door toward the Jackdaw, pages in hand and no new sum.
